[[Zenku]] is a [[Canthan Peasant]] who is driven to thievery by the plague.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}} (spawns randomly along with a [[Market Merchant]] and a [[Canthan Guard]].)

==Dialogue==
{{see|Wajjun Bazaar#Dialogues}}

:''"[[Cantha]] will make it through any difficulty so long as the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]] is alive."''

:''"Fruit can be hard to come by these days now that the plague has slowed trade coming from [[Kryta]]."''

:''"The docks are so empty these days. People are afraid to come to Cantha."''

:''"The emperor cares greatly for all of us who have suffered because of the plague."''

:''"The guards try to keep order but there are fewer of them each day."''

:''"The local guilds are taking over the streets. Most have bought off the [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry]] and do as they please."''

:''"The [[Luxon]]'' {{sic}} ''and [[Kurzick]]s have been quarreling for so long, I think they've probably forgotten why they started fighting to begin with."''

:''"The Ministry of fire'' {{sic}} ''never seems incapable of understanding the plight of the common people."''

:''"The [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] help keep the rogue guilds in check."''

:''"Those [[Am Fah]] thugs are frightening!"''

==Notes==
* He is one of the many [[NPC]]s that randomly [[spawn]] in Wajjun Bazaar.
